text:
infra-monitor: ALB removed 4 targets from alb-edge-prd-1 in us-west-2 -> target group tg-abc123. Reason: Unhealthy (timeout)

josh: seeing alerts, any service name?

infra-monitor: service=ingress-proxy, podselector=ingress-proxy-v2, health_path=/health/readiness, health_code=200 expected, timeout=5s, consecutive_failures=3

marta: I just rolled envoy sidecar 2.1.4 to ingress-proxy last night. Did we change readiness behavior?

adele: envoy change added a metadata fetch to /metadata/local before returning 200. might block if metadata endpoint slow.

samir: logs from pod:
```
[2026-03-17T21:15:12Z] readiness: waiting on metadata fetch (url=http://169.254.169.254/instance-id)
[2026-03-17T21:15:17Z] readiness: metadata fetch timeout after 10s -> responding 504
```

josh: ah that explains ALB timeout (health timeout 5s). We'll get deregisters.

adele: why does envoy call metadata? it's for instance tagging in headers; it shouldn't block readiness. bug in wrapper.

marta: quick temp fix: change k8s readinessProbe timeoutSeconds from 3 to 12 for ingress-proxy. Deploying now.

deploy-bot: rollout started ingress-proxy/v2 -> 6 pods, strategy=RollingUpdate

samir: also raised a NAT egress flakiness alert earlier, but not sure if related.

tony: can we instead change health check path on ALB to /health/liveness so it bypasses metadata? liveness returns 200 immediately.

josh: ALB health checks are per-target-group. That would affect other services. risky during day. prefer fix at pod side.

adele: filed quick PR to short-circuit metadata fetch when AWS env var MDS_DISABLED=true. will roll to canary.

marta: after patch, I see readiness green on 2 pods. ALB re-registered targets.

infra-monitor: Targets re-registered: 4 -> healthy. Final: caused by blocking metadata fetch in envoy sidecar; mitigated by increasing probe timeout + short-term canary patch.

josh: follow-ups: (1) revert blocking metadata call; (2) add per-route health endpoint that doesn't depend on external calls; (3) add metric for metadata fetch latency.

adele: I'll open PRs and a postmortem.

samir: adding note to runbook: when ALB deregisters, check sidecar metadata fetch latencies and readiness timeouts.

marta: :thumbsup: thanks all.
